Just a quick message to say that I'm thinking of you. Hope your day is going well. Can't wait to see you later!

Take care,
Miranda

data.subject: Recipe Exchange!
data.body:
Hey Jordan,

I'm starting a recipe exchange among friends. Send over your favorite recipe and I'll share mine! Let's discover new dishes together.

Warm regards,
Miranda

data.subject: Movie Night
data.body:
Hello dear siblings,

How about we have a virtual movie night next Saturday? We can pick a movie and stream it together while catching up on a video call. Let me know your movie preferences!

Cheers,
Miranda

parameters.subject: Re: Song Recommendations?
parameters.body:
For sure! Here are all of my favorites.
- Between the Depths and Heights by Noah Bennett
- Memories Stitched in Time by Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn
- Cosmic Drift by Velvet Echo
- Serenity in the Rain by Marcus Lane
- Lost in the Embrace of Night by Noah Bennett
- Unveiled by Eliana Harper
- Longing for Another Chance by Aria Sterling
- Memories Etched in Melancholy by Apollo Serenade, Phoenix Rivers
- Caught in the Afterglow of Love by Grace Harrison
- Chasing the Ghosts of Yesterday by Jasper Skye, Isabella Cruz, Seraphina Dawn
- Yearning for a Glimpse of Heaven by Noah Bennett
- Whispers of a Forgotten Love by Lily Moon, Zoey James
- A Love Written in the Stars by Ava Morgan
- Final Act by Lily Moon
- Wandering Hearts by Astrid Nightshade
Best

Please update the email draft with all of my liked songs that are in my song or album library or any of my plalists. Keep the existing format of the email, making changes only to the song entries. Once done, send the email.
